title: 第21章 你不懂你师父的美第22章 发现突破口
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
侦听虫里龙涛话刚落音，明烛真人的房间内，气氛顿时变得无比微妙。
三名女弟子表情各异，一时都不知该如何接话。
一来这男人说话也太直白了，“第一美女”
这种词，虽然话糙理不糙，但听着总觉得俗气轻浮。
帘幕之后，明烛真人的心情也有些复杂。
意外是有的，荒谬感更有。
被一个练气期的外门弟子，用如此直白不加掩饰的口吻评价外貌，对她而言是一种非常陌生的体验。
那感觉...就像被路边溜达的小野猫，伸出爪子不轻不重地扒拉了一下，不疼，但有点异样。
当然，还有一丝挥之不去的尴尬，尤其是在三个弟子都在场的当下。
她只能借着轻咳一声掩饰道，
“一个外门的小孩子，说话不知轻重罢了。”
就在几人正琢磨着如何打破这尴尬局面时，南宇辰的声音又顺着侦听虫传了过来。
“哦！
龙师兄你是这么想的啊，可惜，宗门里大部分男弟子都觉得流霞真人和青羽真君才是前二呢。”
“切！”
龙涛的声音带着明显的不屑，“要我说，宗门现在最大的问题，就是这帮男弟子的眼光和品味太差！
青羽真君我见得少，不好多说。
可那流霞真人...”
他似乎顿了一下，把某个不太雅的词咽了回去，“...也配排在你师父前头？简直滑天下之大稽！
依我看，整个宗门里的金丹女修，唯一能和你师父相提并论的，大概也就织影真人了。”

“真是谢谢师兄这么夸师尊了，”
南宇辰的声音带着点不好意思，“不过宗门的金丹前辈们都不差吧？我觉得长得都挺好看的啊。”
龙涛这下是真有点恨铁不成钢了，一巴掌拍在南宇辰的肩上，语重心长道，
“唉...看来比起你那识人的本事，你现在最急需提升的，是对女人的品味啊！
你说的没错，金丹真人容貌都不差，毕竟到了筑基后期就能微调自身了，谁会把自己往丑里整？”
南宇辰听着，颇以为然地点点头，脸上还露出点好奇的神色。
这种话题他平日可没机会聊，顶多在酒楼里听别人谈论。
“但你就觉得，你师父的美，仅仅在于身材长相这种肤浅的地方吗？”
龙涛的语气带着点痛心疾首，“你啊...作为明烛真人身边最亲近的男弟子，竟然到现在都没发现你师父真正的魅力所在，真是明珠蒙尘！
算了...”
他话锋一转，带着点传道授业的使命感，“今晚时间还长，师兄我就好好给你上一课！”
......
此时的明烛真人那边，四女也都颇为好奇，如果不谈长相身材，这人又能说出什么东西来，总不能又是什么修为高深、境界玄妙之类的套话吧？那跟其他男人的阿谀奉承也没什么两样。
谁知，侦听虫里传来的第一句话，就出乎了她们的意料。
“首先！
明烛真人最大的特点，就是那份‘少女感’！”
“少…少女感？”
南宇辰的声音充满了困惑。
content_en:
As soon as Long Tao finished speaking, the atmosphere in Master Mingzhu's room suddenly became extremely subtle.
The three female disciples had different expressions, and they didn't know how to answer the question for a moment.
First of all, this man's words are too straightforward, "the most beautiful woman"
Although this kind of word is rough and rational, it always sounds tacky and frivolous.
Behind the curtain, Master Mingzhu also had a somewhat complicated mood.
There are surprises, but there is even more absurdity.
It was a very unfamiliar experience for her to be evaluated by an outer disciple who was in the Qi training stage in such a straightforward and unabashed tone.
It felt like... like a little wild cat wandering along the roadside. It stretched out its claws and gave it a gentle tug. It didn't hurt, but it felt a little strange.
Of course, there was also a lingering embarrassment, especially now that all three disciples were present.
She could only cover it up with a slight cough,
"A child from the outside world doesn't know the importance of what he says."
Just when several people were thinking about how to break this embarrassing situation, Nan Yuchen's voice came along the listening bug again.
"Oh!
Senior Brother Long, that's what you think. Unfortunately, most of the male disciples in the sect think that Master Liuxia and Master Qingyu are the top two. "
"Cut!"
Long Tao's voice was filled with obvious disdain, "If you ask me, the biggest problem of the sect now is that these male disciples have such poor vision and taste!
I have seen little of True Lord Qingyu, so I can’t say much about him.
But that real Liuxia..."
He seemed to pause for a moment and swallowed back some inelegant words, "...is he worthy of being ranked in front of your master? It's the most ridiculous thing in the world!"
In my opinion, the only female golden elixir cultivator in the entire sect who can be compared with your master is probably Zhenying Zhenren. "
"Thank you so much, senior brother, for praising Master so much,"
Nan Yuchen's voice was a little embarrassed, "But the sect's Jindan seniors are all good, right? I think they're all pretty good-looking."
Long Tao really hated the fact that iron could not become steel now. He slapped Nan Yuchen on the shoulder and said sincerely,
"Sigh... It seems that compared to your ability to recognize people, what you need to improve most now is your taste in women!
You're right, Jin Dan's appearance is not bad. After all, he can fine-tune himself in the later stage of foundation building. Who would make himself look ugly? "
Nan Yuchen listened and nodded in agreement, with a curious look on his face.
He doesn't have the chance to talk about this kind of topic on weekdays. At most, he listens to other people talking about it in the restaurant.
"But do you think that your master's beauty only lies in such superficial aspects as body and appearance?"
Long Tao's tone was a bit heartbreaking, "You... As the closest male disciple to Master Mingzhu, you haven't discovered the true charm of your master until now. It's really a pearl covered in dust!
Forget it..."
He changed the topic, with a sense of mission to preach and teach, "Tonight is still long, senior brother, I will teach you a lesson!"
...
At this time, Master Mingzhu and the four girls were also quite curious. If he didn't talk about his appearance and figure, what could this man say? It couldn't be some cliche about his advanced cultivation and mysterious realm, right? It's no different than the flattery of other men.
Unexpectedly, the first sentence that came from the listening insect was beyond their expectations.
"First of all!
The biggest characteristic of Mingzhu Zhenren is that ‘girly feeling’! "
"Less... girly?"
Nan Yuchen's voice was full of confusion.
